mechanism: semantic_root_manifest_id is content-addressed over exact expected materialized UnifiedDB schema digest plus explicit inclusion policy
actual schema must equal manifest expected schema before root return
application schema and ordinary typed table rows remain semantic
meta row values are explicitly operational/materialization provenance and excluded
sqlite_sequence remains semantic because AUTOINCREMENT future state is causal
user_version/application_id/encoding are observed but excluded from logical semantic root

hypothesis: Binding root scope to a content-addressed schema+policy manifest removes accidental SQLite-header/meta bookkeeping sensitivity while preserving semantic-data and schema sensitivity, and supplies a typed producer identity for the selected-lineage consumer.
strongest_counterhypothesis: The manifest can still encode a wrong ontology. Excluding all meta rows is valid only while semantic state remains in typed application tables; any intentional semantic use of meta must force an explicit policy/manifest transition. The manifest prevents silent scope drift, not semantic truth by decree.
